title: पापिनी आमा खण्डकाव्यको शैलीवैज्ञानिक अध्ययन {Stylistic study of Papini Ama Khandakavya}
nepali: शोधशीर्षक 		ः पापिनी आमा खण्डकाव्यको शैलीवैज्ञानिक अध्ययन शोधार्थी			ः यमनाथ भण्डारी शोधनिर्देशक		ः सह प्रा.महेश्वर न्यौपाने विभाग÷क्याम्पस 	ः नेपाली भाषा शिक्षा विभाग विश्वविद्यालय क्याम्पस,कीर्तिपुर शैक्षिक वर्ष 		ः २०५९÷०६१  पृष्ठ सङ्ख्या ८९+१३ परिच्छेद छ शोधप्रक्रिया प्रस्तुत शोधकार्य नेपाली भाषा शिक्षा विभागअन्तर्गत एम.एड. दोस्रो वर्षको नेपा.शि.५९८ पाठ्यांशको प्रयोजनका लागि तयार पारिएको हो । छ परिच्छेदमा सङ्गठित यो शोधकार्य “पापिनी आमा” खण्डकाव्यको संरचना पक्षको अध्ययन साथै शैलीवैज्ञानिक दृष्टिले पापिनी आमा खण्डकाव्यको विश्लेषण गर्ने मूल दुई उद्देश्यमा केन्द्रित रहेको छ । मूलतः पुस्तकालयीय विधिमा आधारित भए पनि शोधार्थीले समालोचकका अन्तर्वार्ता अनि प्रारम्भिक स्रोतको रूपमा भने काव्यकारको खण्डकाव्यलाई नै लिइएको छ । यसको  अलावा पाठ्यपुस्तक, पत्रपत्रिका, शब्दकोश, व्याकरणको पनि सहयोग लिइएको छ । खासगरी छ परिच्छेदमा विभाजित यस शोधको पहिलो परिच्छेदमा शोधपरिचय, दोस्रो परिच्छेदमा शैलीविज्ञानको सैद्धान्तिक परिचय, तेस्रो परिच्छेदमा खण्डकाव्यको सैद्धान्तिक स्वरूप वा अवधारणा र विश्लेषणका आधारहरू शीर्षक अन्तर्गत काव्यको परिचय, काव्यको विकासक्रम, खण्डकाव्यको रचना र विकास, खण्डकाव्यका तत्वहरू (शीर्षकीकरण, संरचना, कथावस्तु, पात्रविधान, परिवेशविधान, भावविधान, भाषाशैली, अलङ्कारविधान, लयविधान, दृष्टिविन्दु) को विशेष चर्चा भएको देखिन्छ । त्यसैगरी चौथो परिच्छेदमा पापिनी आमा खण्डकाव्यको संरचनात्मक पक्षको आधारमा विश्लेषण मूल शीर्षकअन्तर्गत कथानक, कथानक विवरण, कथानक संरचना, पात्र, परिवेश, दृष्टिविन्दु, भाषाशैली आदिको शैलीवैज्ञानिक मान्यताका आधारमा विश्लेषण गरेको पाइन्छ । यसक्रममा चरित्र विश्लेषणका क्रममा उक्त काव्यमा प्रयुक्त विभिन्न पात्रहरूलाई लिङ्ग, कार्य, प्रवृत्ति, स्वभाव, जीवनचेतना आसन्नता र आबद्धताका आधारमा केलाउने काम भएको पाइन्छ । पाँचौं परिच्छेदमा पापिनी आमा खण्डकाव्यको चयनका आधारमा विश्लेषण गर्ने काम भएको छ । त्यसमा शब्दचयन  (तत्सम, तद्भव, आगन्तुक) नाम, सर्वनाम , विशेषण, क्रिया, नामयोगी, निपात, संयोजकको चयन र विभिन्न विराम चिन्हहरूको समेत चयनका आधारमा विवेचना गरिएको छ । त्यसैगरी समानता र विचलनका आधारमा सोदाहरणसहित उक्त खण्डकाव्यको विश्लेषण गर्ने काम शोधार्थीले गरेका छन् । शोधनिष्कर्ष छैटौं परिच्छेदमा निष्कर्ष खण्डमा परिच्छेदगत निष्कर्ष प्रस्तुत गर्दै शिक्षाशास्त्रीय दृष्टिले यस खण्डकाव्यको उपयोगिताबारे आ–आफ्नो विचार प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ साथै शैलीवैज्ञानिक दृष्टिले माथि उल्लेख भएका शीर्षकका आधारमा हेर्दा उक्त खण्डकाव्य उत्कृष्ट र स्तरीय देखिन्छ भनिएको छ ।
american_english:
Research title: A Stylistic Study of the Khandakavya Papini Ama
Researcher: Yamnath Bhandari
Research adviser: Associate Professor Maheshwar Neupane
Department/campus: Department of Nepali Language Education, University Campus, Kirtipur
Academic year: 2059/061
Number of pages: 89+13
Sections: six
Research procedure: This research work has been prepared for the purpose of the course Nepa. Shi. 598 of the second year of the M.Ed. under the Department of Nepali Language Education.
This research work, organized in six sections, is centered on two main objectives: the study of the structural aspect of the khandakavya 'Papini Ama', and the analysis of the khandakavya Papini Ama from the stylistic point of view.
Although it is basically based on the library method, the researcher has taken the critics' interviews and, as the primary source, the poet's khandakavya itself.
Besides this, textbooks, newspapers and magazines, dictionaries and grammar have also been used for support.
In this study, divided especially into six sections, the first section contains a research introduction, the second section a theoretical introduction to stylistics, and the third section, under the heading 'Theoretical form or concept of the khandakavya and bases of analysis', appears to contain a special discussion of the introduction to poetry, the development sequence of poetry, the composition and development of the khandakavya, and the elements of the khandakavya (titling, structure, plot, characterization, setting, sentiment, language style, use of figures of speech, rhythm, point of view).
Similarly, in the fourth section, under the main heading 'Analysis on the basis of the structural aspect of the khandakavya Papini Ama', there is found an analysis of plot, plot description, plot structure, characters, setting, point of view, language style and so on on the basis of stylistic tenets.
In this process, in the course of character analysis, there is found the work of examining the various characters used in that poetry on the basis of gender, function, tendency, nature, life consciousness, proximity and attachment.
In the fifth section, the work of analyzing the khandakavya Papini Ama on the basis of selection has been done.
In it, a discussion has been made on the basis of word selection (tatsama, tadbhava, loanwords), the selection of nouns, pronouns, adjectives, verbs, postpositions, particles and conjunctions, and also the selection of various punctuation marks.
Similarly, the researcher has done the work of analyzing the said khandakavya with examples on the basis of parallelism and deviation.
Research conclusion: In the sixth section, in the conclusion part, presenting section-wise conclusions, their respective views on the usefulness of this khandakavya from the pedagogical point of view have been presented, and it has also been said that, seen on the basis of the headings mentioned above from the stylistic point of view, the said khandakavya appears excellent and of a high standard.

australian_english:
Research title: A Stylistic Study of Papini Ama, a Khandakavya
Researcher: Yamnath Bhandari
Research supervisor: Associate Professor Maheshwar Neupane
Department/campus: Department of Nepali Language Education, University Campus, Kirtipur
Academic year: 2059/061
Number of pages: 89+13
Sections: six
Research procedure: This research work was put together for the course Nepa. Shi. 598 in the second year of the M.Ed. under the Department of Nepali Language Education.
This research work, set out in six sections, focuses on two main aims: looking at the structure of the khandakavya 'Papini Ama', and analysing the khandakavya Papini Ama from a stylistic angle.
It is basically built on the library method, but the researcher also took interviews with critics and, as the main source, the poet's khandakavya itself.
On top of that, textbooks, newspapers and magazines, dictionaries and grammar also got a look-in.
In this study, split into six sections, the first section has the research introduction, the second has the theory of stylistics, and the third, under the heading 'The theoretical shape or idea of the khandakavya and the bases for analysis', gives a special look at the introduction to poetry, how poetry developed, how the khandakavya was composed and developed, and the elements of the khandakavya (title, structure, story, characters, setting, feeling, language style, figures of speech, rhythm, point of view).
In the same way, the fourth section, under the main heading 'Analysis based on the structural side of the khandakavya Papini Ama', has a look at the plot, plot details, plot structure, characters, setting, point of view, language style and so on, using stylistic principles.
Along the way, when looking at the characters, the various characters used in the poem get examined on the basis of gender, function, tendency, nature, life awareness, closeness and attachment.
The fifth section does the job of analysing the khandakavya Papini Ama on the basis of choice.
In it, there's a discussion based on word choice (tatsama, tadbhava, loanwords), the choice of nouns, pronouns, adjectives, verbs, postpositions, particles and conjunctions, and also the choice of various punctuation marks.
In the same way, the researcher has analysed the khandakavya with examples on the basis of parallelism and deviation.
What the research found: In the sixth section, the conclusion part gives section-by-section conclusions, sets out their own views on how useful this khandakavya is from a teaching point of view, and also says that, judged on the headings mentioned above from a stylistic angle, the khandakavya comes across as excellent and top-notch.
